children.name: description
children.label: Description
children.default: The OMS turns “Sold out” into “Pre-order” or “Backorder” on the product page as soon as a purchase order is on the way, with a delivery date taken from that purchase order. Sales stop at the quantity the purchase order covers, and orders wait until the stock arrives, then route like any other order.

children.name: description
children.label: Description
children.default: Run one real purchase order through HotWax, click by click, from pre-order to release.

children.name: steps
children.label: Steps
children.help_text: Four steps, in the order the demo runs. Tab name shows above the demo; title and text show on the start card.

default.title: Turn on pre-order
default.text: Turn an incoming purchase order into stock shoppers can pre-order online.

default.title: Orders wait for the stock
default.text: Each pre-order reserves a unit, and sales stop at what is coming.

default.title: Move the date
default.text: The supplier is late, so waiting customers get the new date.

default.title: Receive and release
default.text: The jackets arrive, and the waiting pre-orders go to fulfillment first.

children.name: note
children.label: Note
children.default: About a minute. Real order, real screens.
